titleEn: Delete the Middle Node of a Linked List
title: 删除链表的中间节点
summary: 删除零基下标 floor(n/2) 的链表节点并返回头节点。
insight: 快指针每次两步、慢指针每次一步，同时维护慢指针前驱；快指针到尾时慢指针恰在中间，跳过它即可。单节点直接返回空。
pitfalls: 偶数长度删除右侧中点

solutions.title: 快慢指针与前驱
solutions.idea: 一次遍历定位 floor(n/2) 节点。
steps: fast 可走两步时 previous=slow、slow=slow.next、fast=fast.next.next；结束 previous.next=slow.next

code.java: class Solution { public ListNode deleteMiddle(ListNode head){if(head.next==null)return null;ListNode slow=head,fast=head,previous=null;while(fast!=null&&fast.next!=null){previous=slow;slow=slow.next;fast=fast.next.next;}previous.next=slow.next;return head;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun deleteMiddle(head:ListNode?):ListNode?{if(head!!.next==null)return null;var slow:ListNode?=head;var fast:ListNode?=head;var previous:ListNode?=null;while(fast!=null&&fast.next!=null){previous=slow;slow=slow!!.next;fast=fast.next!!.next};previous!!.next=slow!!.next;return head} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: ListNode* deleteMiddle(ListNode* head){if(!head->next)return nullptr;ListNode *slow=head,*fast=head,*previous=nullptr;while(fast&&fast->next){previous=slow;slow=slow->next;fast=fast->next->next;}previous->next=slow->next;return head;} };
